wes does not like the hat . wes likes the cap .
lia did not order the kite . lia ordered the drum .
the ticket is not cheap . it is expensive .
kai said the tree is not young today . it is grown .
ivy did not buy the cake . ivy bought the cookies .
ivy did not pick the pen . ivy picked the pencil .

priya thinks the river looks dry instead of wet .
nora thinks the shelf looks tight instead of loose .
the cloth is cheap , not expensive .
the bag is big , not small .
sam thinks the task looks dull instead of sharp .
a clean stone is the opposite of a dirty stone .
the sky is bright , not dark .
